decisions.statement: A reader who is not signed in imports nothing.
A hash the codec will not decode is refused rather than part-imported.
A hash the reader already has gives back the build already filed.
A build named against a game character is live.
A build named against no game character is private.
The build name is the race and the class rather than the name the hash had.
The cookies the sign-in set are carried onto the answer.

definition: a character build decoded from a hash and filed against the reader's account
